body: [guicanvas] is a canvas you draw on with messages. Drawing commands pile up in a list per layer and are only drawn when it gets a bang, so a redraw usually starts with 'clear'. Coordinates are in pixels from the top left corner and colors are in RGB. It also reports mouse clicks and movement over it.
